name: agent-skills-mods
description: See your agent-skills spec, plan and tasks inside Claude Code: a task board, a progress band above the prompt, an ETA range, sprints and a local dashboard, all read from the markdown you already have.

planSpinner.title: Spinner in plan terms
planSpinner.description: Replace the spinner's random word with what the agent is doing in plan terms, such as "Building T4" or "Testing T4".

specGate.title: Spec gate warning
specGate.description: Warn (never block) when source files change while SPEC.md is still awaiting approval.

chartStyle.title: Terminal chart style
chartStyle.description: auto: pictures on kitty and Ghostty, braille and block characters elsewhere. pixels: always pictures. cells: always characters.

progressFormat.title: Keep the progress format
progressFormat.description: Add and update Status lines and front matter in SPEC.md, tasks/plan.md and tasks/todo.md (status, created, approved, started, done, step), and tell Claude the format's rules.

checkpointGate.title: Checkpoint gate warning
checkpointGate.description: Warn (never block) when source files change while a reached checkpoint still waits for your review.

notifications.title: Native notifications
notifications.description: Send a notification through your notification channel when a checkpoint is reached, the last task is done, or a test run fails on the current task.
